metadata.title: Stellar binaries incident on supermassive black hole binaries: implications for double tidal disruption events, calcium-rich transients, and hypervelocity stars

notes: No eligible individual stars are identified. The paper presents population-level simulations of stellar binaries interacting with a supermassive black hole binary. ASASSN-15lh (T:p6-b3) and iPTF15eqv (T:p7-b3) are discussed as transients, not as Galactic unbound stars, and the hypervelocity stars discussed are generic/simulated populations without individual identifiers.
